name: qa_cpu_heavy
title: OS-FINALQA FQA-7, QA-GLB-156, OS-DENSE: the STRESS test, Heavy12 (6 Modern + 4 Amiga sampler voices, TB-303, FM, delay, plate HALF, limiter) opened from File and played for a 60 s window (24 reads of `cpu`, 2.5 s apart) after 5 s of settling. ASSERTS the controllability the main-loop guard keeps: every read answers within 1 s, the guard line is read, the UI responds, Stop works. Underruns, shed blocks and the mean are REPORTED, not asserted. The project must be on the card first (`o3pj_tool gen heavy`)

steps.say: OS-DENSE: Heavy12 is the STRESS test (cpu-budget.md section 4): 12 tracks (6 Modern + 4 Amiga sampler voices, TB-303, FM). It is over the CPU budget on the unit (mean about 113 %, worst about 147 % on v1.0.0-fqa.8, 477d5d9, unit run of 2026-10-23), so this scenario asserts that the unit stays controllable (the main-loop guard of OS-MAINGUARD) and REPORTS underruns, shed blocks and the mean. BEFORE the run: build the song (`o3pj_tool gen heavy <dir>/Heavy/project.o3pj`, with the folder <dir>/Heavy/samples made first) and copy the folder Heavy into Projects/ on the card (card reader or the unit's USB Disk mode). Use the release image, then the bench image (-DO3OS_BENCH=ON) of the same build id: cpu-budget.md section 5.
